question: Who has been appointed as the Deputy Election Commissioner of India in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajay Bhadoo.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ajay Bhadoo **was appointed as the **Deputy Election Commissioner **of India in **October 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunil Arora** was the **Chief Election Commissioner of India** from **2017 to 2020.** 
 
• **Om Prakash Rawat** was the **Chief Election Commissioner of India **from **2018 to 2019.**
 
• **Rajiv Kumar **is an** Indian economist** and the **Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog.**
